rules.rule: Think in probabilities. Each trade is a unique event within a series.
rules.author: Mark Douglas

rules.rule: Define your edge clearly. Execute it mechanically without hesitation.
rules.author: Mark Douglas

rules.rule: Accept the risk BEFORE placing the trade. Eliminate hope and fear.
rules.author: Mark Douglas

rules.rule: Consistency comes from executing your edge, not from being right.
rules.author: Mark Douglas

rules.rule: System Quality Number (SQN) > 2.5 is good, > 5 is excellent.
rules.author: Van Tharp
rules.source: Trade Your Way to Financial Freedom

rules.rule: Express every trade as R-multiples. Expectancy > 0 over a large sample is the goal.
rules.author: Van Tharp
rules.source: Trade Your Way to Financial Freedom

rules.rule: Position sizing is the most critical factor in overall performance.
rules.author: Van Tharp
rules.source: Trade Your Way to Financial Freedom

rules.rule: Define your objectives before designing your system.
rules.author: Van Tharp
rules.source: Trade Your Way to Financial Freedom

rules.rule: All great traders focus on risk management, not returns.
rules.author: Jack Schwager

rules.rule: Have a clearly defined methodology. Follow it with discipline.
rules.author: Jack Schwager

rules.rule: Cut losses short, let profits run. The asymmetry is essential.
rules.author: Jack Schwager

rules.rule: Adapt your approach to current market type (trending vs ranging).
rules.author: Jack Schwager
